node: Behind-the-meter power generation, gas turbines, generators, and turbine services
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a two-lane universe for behind-the-meter gas power tied to AI/data-center power scarcity. GE Vernova is the necessary reference leader because turbine slot scarcity validates the chokepoint, but the more underfollowed mapping is in modular onsite gas generation, distributed-power operators, gas compression/engine-service platforms, and emissions-control vendors that help data centers bypass grid queues or obtain permits. The strongest underfollowed direct candidates in this pass are ERock, Enerflex, Kodiak Gas Services, and Fuel Tech; Fuel Tech is a micro-cap speculative exception because its data-center gas-turbine SCR case study is unusually direct.
